items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: George, George and, uh, Howard and Jim was on this side of me... And I really must say I loved his playing.

ctx.x: No trombone? Yeah, Jim Robinson. Oh Jim, yeah. Well we stayed there for about two years I'd say. Yeah. Then Reverend Kershaw in the meantime when we was playing out there they came down here and heard different bands and they selected our band.
